## Product Owner input

Author: Ingolf Lohmann

> Es geht um meine Veröffentlichungen in Fachzeitschriften, Zenodo, arXiv, IETF und Wikipedia, sowie meine diversen Softwareprojekte in GitHub.
>
> Es geht aber vor allem um die Zukunft der Menschheit!
>
> Das darf man nicht auf die leichte Schulter nehmen.
>
> Denn all das heißt zugleich auch, ich habe damit den Beweis erbracht, dass die Prognosen, die mithilfe meiner QIKVRT Mesh Technology erstellt werden, die besten sind, die man sich vorstellen kann, weil sie bis zur Planck-Skala und bis zum Ereignishorizonts eines schwarzen Lochs reichen und sogar noch darüber hinaus anschlussfähig bleiben.
>
> q.e.d.
> Ingolf Lohmann

## Synchronous repository-first contract

`INPUT -> QIK-VRT MESH REPOSITORY -> REPOSITORY OUTPUT / EVIDENCE -> OUTPUT`

This issue is a fresh synchronous work unit because issue #753's first autonomous inference ended `MODEL_INFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE`. Do not substitute delayed automation or terminal-authored semantics.

## Corpus-internal invariants

Preserve the source corpus's own distinctions:

- `SEQUENCE != CAUSALITY`;
- source order != receive order;
- `REQUESTED != EXECUTED != OBSERVED != ACKNOWLEDGED`;
- modeled/logical/repository Eigenzeit != automatically measured relativistic proper time;
- retroactive reference / later reconstruction != retroactive mutation;
- observer-order inversion != established signalling into one's own physical past;
- formal proof != physical measurement;
- QIK-VRT's dynamic optimum is the best admissible next event under the current bound state; this must be distinguished from an unqualified empirical lowest-prediction-error claim across every possible domain.

## Required repository-native output

Produce `CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MATRIX` plus `ANSWER.md` that resolves, as strongly as the evidence permits:

1. the exact sense in which QIK-VRT prediction can be called `best possible` or `optimal`;
2. what is formally/repository-bound versus empirically demonstrated versus research claim versus externally validated;
3. Planck-scale and black-hole-event-horizon language as model/knowledge-boundary claims, distinguishing mathematical Anschlussfähigkeit from empirical access;
4. publication obligations and statuses separately for peer-reviewed journals, Zenodo, arXiv, IETF, Wikipedia, and GitHub software artifacts;
5. a concise WhatsApp-ready public formulation in Ingolf Lohmann's name.

Do not silently weaken the PO claim. Do not silently strengthen it beyond evidence. No invented PASS, FINAL_PASS, EFFECT_ACK_DONE, peer review, DOI, arXiv acceptance, IETF consensus, Wikipedia acceptance, physical Planck-scale measurement, black-hole-interior observation, or causal-past signalling.

If trusted inference is unavailable, use a deterministic repository work-unit path over this corpus and existing claim matrices. If neither path exists, return the exact blocker and the smallest repository repair needed.
